name: @spences10/pi-observability
description: Optional live event stream and local web dashboard for Pi agent sessions
author: Scott Spence <me@scottspence.com>

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run build:self
scripts.build:self: vp exec vite build && vp exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/schema.sql dist/ && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp node_modules/@fontsource/victor-mono/files/victor-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/victor-mono/files/victor-mono-latin-700-normal.woff2 dist/fonts/
scripts.check: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run check:self
scripts.check:self: vp exec vite build && vp exec svelte-check --tsconfig src/web/tsconfig.json && vp exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run test:self
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter "$npm_package_name^..." run build:self && pnpm run coverage:self
